author: tristanobernardelli
name: smoke-ring-solar-shader
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Smoke Ring style. Solar variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#101010, #F5F5F5, #B0B0B0, #3A3A3A). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
